Instructions for Use
Device description: The Umbra Vena Cava Filter is a vena cava filter. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Umbra Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
- Static magnetic field of 3 Tesla or less
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 4,000-G/cm (40-T/m)
- B1+rms ≤ 1.2 uT; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 1.2 W/kg
- Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
- Scan for up to 20 minutes
- Integrated Whole Body Transmit Coil
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Umbra Vena Cava Filter is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
In non-clinical testing, the image artifact caused by the device extends approximately 5 mm from the device when imaged with a gradient echo pulse sequence and a 3 T MR system.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
